description: Running EC2 Security Group Allows Unrestricted Internet Egress
rationale: A security group attached to at least one running EC2 instance allows all protocols and ports to 0.0.0.0/0 or ::/0. This is a least-privilege review, not evidence of internet routing, attack, or exfiltration.
remediation: If policy requires restricted egress, scope outbound protocols and destinations; consider VPC endpoints, proxies and approved egress gateways.
